haikus.haiku:
Morning light drips sweet
Fluffy crumbs float like clouds soft
Scent fills warm room soft
Happy #NationalSpongecakeDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Quirky kids giggle
Toys spin, lights dance in bright rooms
Joyful chaos feels
Happy #InternationalWeirdParentsDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Bright jazz steps glide soft
Star‑lit shoes tap the bright floor
Joy hums in each beat
#HappyBirthdayGeneKelly from @ClamBakeSanta
